referenceFunction.generalComment: The average net efficiency is 70 %. The stove is assumed to fire anthracite. The heating value (32.4 MJ/kg) and the composition of the anthracite are average values available from the literature. The emission data are also taken from literature reporting measurements performed at the end of the 1980s in Germany. Size distribution of particles has been estimated on the basis of recent information from EPA. Emissions of trace elements were calculated using the ash content in the coal and average transfer coefficients for coal power plants with ash retention of 98 %, as first approximation.; UUID: 26053add-4c4c-3672-8b7e-4b923151810b
